question_text: Construct a 3NF schema for a therapy centre. Each client has ClientID, name and DOB. Each specialist has SpecialistID and name. A room has RoomID, building and room number. Each booking has BookingID, one client, one specialist, one room and start date/time. Show primary and foreign keys.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: CLIENT(ClientID PK, Name, DOB); SPECIALIST(SpecialistID PK, Name); ROOM(RoomID PK, Building, RoomNumber); BOOKING(BookingID PK, ClientID FK→CLIENT, SpecialistID FK→SPECIALIST, RoomID FK→ROOM, StartDateTime).

marking_points.criterion: Separate CLIENT with its own key and attributes.
Separate SPECIALIST with its own key and attributes.
Separate ROOM with its own key and location attributes.
BOOKING has BookingID primary key and start datetime.
BOOKING references CLIENT and SPECIALIST by foreign keys.
BOOKING references ROOM; descriptive client/specialist/room attributes are not duplicated in booking.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: No executable code required; manual technical check.
